verdict.rationale: Alloy is a KYC/AML and fraud-monitoring platform, so an approval gate before submitting regulatory reports (such as SAR filings) is a fair question for it. The evidence never describes regulatory report submission or a required authorized sign-off before external filing. Mentions of manual review events, investigations, and "fully auditable agentic automation" are adjacent features, not a documented approval gate on outbound regulatory reports.

support.subject: As a compliance-officer, I can require an authorized human approval before an externally submitted regulatory report
